files.origin: live streamText loop (T15), five scripted beats: read notes/alpha.md → re-read (tool_recall) → edit append (2nd page) → fresh read notes/beta.md (new contentHash, no fault) → read notes/ghost.md (thrown tool error, tool-error part, no page)
live streamText loop (T15), three scripted rounds re-reading notes/{a,b,c}.md in order (9 reads) — sustained re-fetch pressure, pre-eviction thrash shape

limitations: v0 tracer has no eviction path (declared ⇒ resident): the live thrash drop exercises sustained re-fetch pressure (3 files × 3 rounds → one tool_recall fault per page·source) but cannot exhibit page.evict or second-slot paging. The synthetic P-pathology vector in corpus/m1 remains the eviction-shape reference.

Faults are deduped per page·source by the tracer, so kinds of repeats: round 2's re-reads trip all three tool_recall faults; round 3's repeats are lawful repeat pressure carried by call.meta per-turn hit/miss estimates instead of new fault rows (same law the M2 drop documented).

The T15 adapter is trace-only mirror mode (m7 rulings): no UC1/UC2 port, no control path (assistant text is never rewritten; transformParams returns params unchanged; the tap yields every fullStream part untouched).
Design risk 1 counts witness: middlewareRenders == tapStepEnds on both traces (10/10 and 6/6); mirrorCountsAgree=true in both sidecars. A divergence would taint the sidecar, never mis-score.
budgetTokens=120000 is the T15 fixture convention (the T9/m2 crew used 200000); it is declared headroom bookkeeping, not the provider's measured context window.

Free-tier model behaviour varies; beats were induced by explicit step-by-step prompts, captured in one run each (no retries). The recorded traces carry the model's hidden reasoning only as pass-through fullStream parts (thinking disabled per-beat; providers reasoning channels are never paged).
